checks.message: Boundary is explicitly provisional_constraint with official_boundary=false; eligible for content scoring but never described as an official redline. Full-chain replacement and recalculation are required when official geometry arrives.
All three mandatory key areas are present and explicitly provisional; their working areas are used only for design discussion and reproducible intake review.
Twenty-five concept polygons share boundaries, remain inside the site, have no material overlaps, and completely cover the current working boundary.
Spatial review passes containment, key-area presence, land-use coverage and metric consistency; only the intended provisional-boundary notices remain.
Known spatial metrics are calculated in EPSG:4548 from submitted GeoJSON and align with static HTML declarations; unsupported regulatory metrics remain unknown.
Twelve scenario nodes include limited-window status, human review, minimum-data policy, an exit condition and a non-digital fallback; four are explicitly industry-validation concepts.
Static visualization is complete and offline, references only local figures, contains no forms, remote media, scripts, network calls or tracking, and matches metrics.json.
Proposal references all registered sources, known metrics, nine geometry files, six standards and fifteen required design-depth items.
A3 booklet and A0 boards contain real pages, use the same five generated figures, and remain below repository file-size limits.
Submission graphics, geometry, text and layouts are original; no third-party photos, map tiles, portraits, logos or remotely loaded assets are embedded.
Missing parcel, ownership, control-plan, building survey, transport, municipal, fire, ecological and heritage data are disclosed; legal intensity and construction claims remain unknown.
